findings.claim: ADR-0016 says the hook payload carries agent_type for tool calls inside a subagent and reads .claude/agents/<type>.md. On Qwen, PreToolUse/PostToolUse carry only agent_id (no agent_type), and custom agents live in .qwen/agents/.
findings.evidence: qwen-code@18f80f5 hooks/types.ts:274-275 'Present only when the event fires inside a subagent. agent_id?'; hookEventHandler.ts:516-523 PreToolUseInput has no agent_type; createBaseInput 1231 adds only agent_id; subagents/subagent-manager.ts:1832-1833 path.join(projectRoot, QWEN_DIR, 'agents'). v1 hooks/pretooluse.mjs:167 checks agent_id OR agent_type.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 85f64d2c 2026-06-21 'fix(hooks): respect subagent ctx tool availability (#834)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'const isSubagentContext = input.agent_id != null || input.agent_type != null'. REGRESSION_RISK: a v2 keyed on agent_type alone treats every Qwen subagent call as main session (case A deny naming ctx tools the subagent may not have: #794/#1037 dead end). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: detect subagent by agent_id OR agent_type; per-agent agents dir in adapters/table.ts.
findings.fix: Per agent row: subagent marker field (Qwen: agent_id), agents dir (Qwen: .qwen/agents, ~/.qwen/agents), and how the type is resolved when only agent_id is present (else case B/C, never allow). Add GP3 golden from a recorded Qwen subagent payload.

findings.claim: 'Qwen: rewrite supported' is only partly true. Qwen refuses updatedInput for managed tool invocations and turns it into a deny; for normal tools updatedInput restarts the permission flow, so under approval mode 'ask' the user must confirm the rewritten run.mjs command.
findings.evidence: qwen-code managed-tool-runtime.ts:68-85 'PreToolUse updatedInput is not supported for managed tool invocations; the tool was not run.'; coreToolScheduler.ts:4388-4394 allowApplies needs !requiresUserInteraction; 4473-4484 'A replacement input is checked from the start of the permission flow'.
findings.fix: Change the Qwen cell to: rewrite on normal tools only, re-enters permission flow; managed tools fall to case C. Add an LV check for Qwen case B under default and yolo modes.

findings.claim: Manifest list names gemini-extension.json but not qwen-extension.json. Qwen picks qwen-extension.json first; a converted gemini-extension.json gets no hook-name conversion, and Qwen then loads hooks/hooks.json raw, so Gemini names (BeforeTool/AfterTool/BeforeAgent) would never fire on Qwen. ADR-0011 'Qwen: same form' hides this.
findings.evidence: qwen-code extension/extension-converter.ts SUPPORTED_EXTENSION_MANIFESTS = [EXTENSIONS_CONFIG_FILENAME, 'gemini-extension.json', ...]; variables.ts:22 'qwen-extension.json'; gemini-converter.ts has 0 matches for 'hook' (converts only TOML commands, lines 90-93); extensionManager.ts:1985-2000 loads config.hooks or hooks/hooks.json when format==='qwen'; hooks/types.ts:24-64 has no BeforeTool.
findings.fix: Generate a separate qwen-extension.json with its own hooks (Claude names) from adapters/table.ts; never share one hooks.json between Gemini and Qwen. Add a GP test that installs the built tree with qwen extensions install and lists hooks.

findings.claim: Qwen tool name is given as one value. Install via the Claude-marketplace path gives mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__*; extension install keeps server key. The row must name the install mode (PRD E14: one install mode per agent).
findings.evidence: v1 commit 74245655 body: 'Own context-mode MCP surfaces as both mcp__plugin_context-mode_context-mode__* (Claude marketplace shim) and mcp__context-mode__*'; spike-distribution.md:17 'also Claude marketplace <url>:<plugin>'; qwen tool-name-utils.ts:8-9 max 63, [A-Za-z0-9_-] (longest v1 name 58 chars, no hash suffix).
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 74245655 2026-05-12 'feat(qwen-code): route external MCP tools through PreToolUse (closes #529 partial)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'The negative lookahead excludes both.' REGRESSION_RISK: matcher built for one name misses the other (#529/#1222 class). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: fix one install mode for Qwen and record its name from a native payload (GP3).
findings.fix: State Qwen install mode = qwen extension (not Claude marketplace) and that the name is mcp__context-mode__<tool>; matcher tested on a recorded payload.

findings.claim: Qwen is a 'required' live tier needing a provider key. Owner decision: no API keys for tests; ADR-0012 installs only claude and codex, others SKIPPED. So Qwen hooks (compact, deny, rewrite) get no E2E at all, while E2E is wanted.

findings.claim: Qwen SessionStart(compact) exists but fires as 'void' (not awaited) after compaction; its additionalContext applies whenever the hook finishes, so the next model turn may run without it.
